title: 4 days left to win Dh100K for free: Dear Big Ticket submission ends July 27
text:
Big Ticket gives residents a chance to turn dreams into reality
Abu Dhabi: With just four days to go, Big Ticket Abu Dhabi is urging UAE residents to submit their entries for Season 3 of the ‘Dear Big Ticket’ campaign. It is a heartwarming initiative that gives people the chance to turn their dreams into reality.
Running until July 27, the campaign invites participants to share their heartfelt wishes in one of five categories: health and wellbeing, education, housing and accommodation, business and entrepreneurship, or family reunion.
Whether it’s help with medical treatment, support for a child’s tuition, or the chance to reunite with a loved one, the initiative is designed to bring meaningful dreams to life. Participation is open to all UAE residents aged 18 and above, and it’s completely free – no Big Ticket purchase is necessary.
Wishes can be submitted in writing (up to 1,000 characters) or through a 1-minute video on www.dearbigticket.ae by July 27.
From August 4 to 24, five wishes will be shortlisted each week. The public will be able to vote for their favourite stories online or through Asianet, with each vote doubling as an entry into a weekly draw for one of five free Big Tickets.
Each week, the two most-voted wishes will receive Dh100,000 to help make their dreams come true. Winners will be announced between September 1 and 15.
The remaining nine shortlisted wishes each week will also receive Dh10,000.
Over three weeks, a total of six lucky winners will receive Dh100,000 each.
Wish submission period: Up until July 27
Voting period: August 4 to 24
Winner announcements: September 1 to 15
